text: The Altrad group is a family-owned industrial group led by its founder and chairman Mohed Altrad, who holds 96.95% of the shares; minority shareholders Arkea and Tikehau hold the remaining 3.05%.
short: Mohed Altrad holds 96.95% of the Altrad group

source.name: Altrad Annual Report 2025 (PDF): 3.1 Board structure
source.quote: The Board members have been nominated by the shareholders: Mohed Altrad (96.95%), alongside minority shareholders (3.05%) including Arkea and Tikehau.
source.note: Same report, 'Our model' section, lists 'Family-owned' among the group's value-creation points and says 'Altrad Group continues to be led by its founder, Mohed Altrad'.

additionalSources.name: Forbes: 'Who Is Mohed Altrad, The Billionaire Scaffolding King Found Guilty Of Rugby Bribery?'
additionalSources.quote: making his stake (he owns 80% of the company) worth an estimated $1 billion
additionalSources.note: Republishes Forbes' March 2015 profile 'From Bedouin To Billionaire', so the 80% figure is as of 2015; the annual report's 96.95% is the current figure.
